description: Changes settings on one or more proxies at once: auto-renewal on or off, a comment, and the timer that rotates a mobile proxy's IP automatically every N minutes. Only the settings you pass are changed.

auto_renewal.description: Renew automatically from the balance before expiry

auto_rotate_minutes.description: Rotate the IP automatically every N minutes (2-1440); 0 turns the timer off

comment.description: Free-text label shown in the dashboard; empty string clears it

name: update_proxy_settings
title: Update proxy settings
